lines: Still water today. Mind your step on the stones.

lines: Boars came down to drink. Now they won't leave.
npcGlasswater.offer.speaker: npcGlasswater

lines: Still mud in the water. Still boars.
npcGlasswater.notReady.speaker: npcGlasswater

lines: Clear again. Here, two draughts for the road.
npcGlasswater.thanks.speaker: npcGlasswater
